events.title: Mick Jagger turns 83
events.blurb: Sir Michael Philip Jagger, lead singer of The Rolling Stones, was born on this day in Dartford, Kent.

angles.name: Rock Legend
angles.copy: Eighty-three years young today! Raise a glass to the legendary Mick Jagger, still strutting and rolling with the best of them.

events.title: MTV launched, playing 'Video Killed The Radio Star'
events.blurb: On August 1, 1981, MTV launched in the United States, famously kicking off with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star'.

angles.name: Music TV History
angles.copy: Forty-five years ago today, the world changed for music lovers as MTV launched, forever altering how we consume our favourite tracks.

events.title: Oasis' 'Definitely Maybe' anniversary
events.blurb: On August 29, 1994, Oasis released their iconic debut album 'Definitely Maybe', which became the fastest-selling debut album in British history.

angles.name: Britpop Classic
angles.copy: A quarter-century since Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and changed the sound of British music. What's your favourite track from this era-defining album?

events.title: Woodstock Festival 57th anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place from August 15-18, 1969, on a dairy farm in Bethel, New York, attracting nearly half a million people.

angles.name: Peace & Music
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since half a million people gathered for '3 Days of Peace & Music' at Woodstock. An iconic moment in music history.

events.title: Anniversary of Elvis Presley's passing
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll', passed away on August 16, 1977, at the age of 42.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: Remembering the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who left us on this day. His music and legacy continue to inspire generations.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', was released in the UK on September 26, 1969, and in the US on October 1, 1969, featuring iconic tracks like 'Come Together' and 'Here Comes the Sun'.

angles.name: Iconic Album
angles.copy: One of the most recognisable album covers and a timeless collection of songs. The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' still sounds as fresh today.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the American-British singer, songwriter, and founding member of The Pretenders, was born on this day in 1951.

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the inimitable Chrissie Hynde! A true rock icon and a powerful voice in music for decades.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: William John Paul Gallagher, best known as the lead singer of Oasis and later Beady Eye, was born on this day in Manchester in 1972.

angles.name: Rock Star Birthday
angles.copy: Our kid Liam Gallagher is 54 today! Still bringing that iconic swagger to the stage. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic solo single 'Imagine' was released in the US on October 11, 1971, and as a UK single in 1975, becoming a timeless anthem for peace.

angles.name: Peace Anthem
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since John Lennon gave the world 'Imagine', a song that continues to resonate with its powerful message of peace and unity.

events.title: Anniversary of the first iPod release
events.blurb: The revolutionary first-generation Apple iPod, which transformed portable music, was officially introduced to the world on October 23, 2001.

angles.name: Tech Revolution
angles.copy: Remember life before? Twenty-five years ago, the original iPod dropped, putting '1,000 songs in your pocket' and changing music consumption forever.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Celebrating over six decades of 007, from iconic theme tunes to unforgettable cinematic moments. What's your favourite Bond film?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Winston Ono Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles and an iconic solo artist, was born on this day in Liverpool in 1940.

angles.name: Remembering a Legend
angles.copy: Remembering the visionary John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His music and message of peace continue to resonate globally.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary English actor, comedian, and writer John Marwood Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, was born on this day in Weston-super-Mare in 1939.

angles.name: Comedy Genius
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the utterly brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty, a true titan of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968, showcasing the band's diverse musical directions.

angles.name: Double Album Delight
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unleashed the sprawling, eclectic masterpiece that is 'The White Album'. A truly monumental record.
